name: Interactive TUI triage face
summary: Add an interactive tcell TUI over the existing three-phase pipeline: live scan or read-only --from snapshot, master-detail triage, consented quarantine and restore through the same hardened act path. ABORT-gated at rc3.
targetWindow: Personal/beta now; public publish gated on field false-positive measurement

required.title: Interactive tcell TUI
required.summary: Pure Model + update(key)->[]Cmd with tcell only at the view/Run edge; master-detail triage, filter/sort, quarantine-with-confirm and restore via a locally-defined Actor interface. Imports only internal/model (enforced by TestDecouplingInvariant).

required.title: TUI ABORT convertibility conditions (C1-C5)
required.summary: Signal handler restores the terminal on external kill; --from bounded (16MiB cap, byte-guard) and defended in depth (actor read-only refusal, Unicode-spoof strip); Done cleared on any restore result; tcell vendored + architext drift fixed + CI import-guard; width/modal guards + visible() benchmarked.

deferred.title: Per-item undo in the TUI
deferred.summary: Session 'u' restores the whole session, not a single item.
deferred.reason: Requires the Actor interface to return per-item outcomes; a schema change out of scope for the rc3 hardening batch. Coarse session undo plus CLI manifest-restore covers recovery in the meantime.

deferred.title: Carry collector gaps in --json snapshots
deferred.summary: A --from snapshot omits collector gap info shown on a live scan.
deferred.reason: Changing the --json contract to embed gaps risks the stable snapshot format; a snapshot is a point-in-time export, and a live scan surfaces gaps. Sequenced after the format stabilizes.

outOfScope.title: Web reporting UI
outOfScope.summary: A browser reporting face was floated for after the CLI/TUI prove out; not part of this release.

workstreams.name: TUI triage face
workstreams.summary: Interactive triage over []Assessment, thin over the pipeline, acting only through the hardened act path. ABORT-gated at rc3 with all convertibility conditions met.

blockers.title: Field false-positive rate unmeasured
blockers.summary: Personal/beta use is GO, but a general-public GO is gated on measuring the real-world false-positive rate on live Macs (a condition inherited from the CLI ABORT). The TUI adds no new public blocker now that C1-C5 are closed.
blockers.nextAction: Run CounterSpy across a set of real Macs and record the actionable-finding false-positive rate before any public release.
evidenceNeeded: Measured false-positive rate on live machines

evidence.label: go test ./... + vet + gofmt + architext validate
